description: Static attack-surface audit of an extracted Electron app directory (asar output or unpacked app/). Finds ungated contextBridge IPC passthroughs, bulk ipcMain service-registry registration, unvalidated handlers reaching file/exec sinks, weak webPreferences. PREFER THIS over manual grep for the initial sweep — it encodes known Electron exposure patterns and costs one call. Returns a markdown findings report; full JSON lands at /tmp/wc-audit.json.
